comparison.navigator: Search LinkedIn people and accounts, then inspect role history and shared connections.
comparison.apollo: Search company and contact records by your target criteria.
comparison.verdict: Use the tool that finds the right person at your actual target accounts. Check the role before contacting them.

comparison.navigator: Saved leads and accounts surface updates, including role changes and recent activity.
comparison.apollo: Research and enrichment features can update records and support prospecting; access varies by plan.
comparison.verdict: An update is useful when it gives you a relevant reason to contact the buyer. Treat it as a research cue.

comparison.navigator: Contact details can come from member profiles, your connected CRM or information your team adds.
comparison.apollo: Email and personal phone requests use credits. Coverage and returned number types vary.
comparison.verdict: For a team missing contact data, we would test Apollo or another provider first. Inspect a sample before buying more.

comparison.navigator: InMail reaches LinkedIn members. It does not provide a built-in cold calling dialer.
comparison.apollo: Sequences and calling features sit alongside the database. Plan access and usage charges apply.
comparison.verdict: Price the calling setup you will use, including the numbers, minutes and any required add-ons.

comparison.navigator: No native lead/account CSV or XLS export. Advanced Plus offers supported CRM Sync and lead-creation routes.
comparison.apollo: CSV exports and CRM integrations are available, with plan and operation limits.
comparison.verdict: Test the transfer of a few records. Confirm that phone types, ownership and follow-up notes remain usable.

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn Sales Navigator worth it for lead generation?
faqs.a: It earns its cost when better targeting, account updates or introductions improve your outreach. It is a weak purchase when you mainly need phone numbers and already know your buyers. Test a small set of real accounts and record useful contacts, qualified conversations, held meetings and research time.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Sales Navigator and Apollo?
faqs.a: Sales Navigator focuses on LinkedIn-based prospect research and relationships. Apollo combines contact data with outreach software. Both help with prospecting, but their contact access, exports and costs differ. Choose around the part of your sales process that needs work.

faqs.q: How do you generate leads with Sales Navigator?
faqs.a: Define suitable companies, find the relevant buying role and check a business reason to approach them. Save useful prospects and review changes that affect your offer. Then obtain a contact route, reach out, qualify the conversation and record the next action in your CRM.

faqs.q: Does Sales Navigator give you phone numbers and email addresses?
faqs.a: It can display contact details from a member's profile, a connected CRM or information added by your team. That does not guarantee a usable phone number or email for each person. Check the available details and use a suitable contact provider to fill gaps.

faqs.q: Can you export Sales Navigator leads to CSV?
faqs.a: LinkedIn does not offer native CSV or XLS export of Sales Navigator lead and account information. Advanced Plus provides supported CRM Sync and lead-creation options. Check your plan and CRM compatibility before buying around an export workflow.

faqs.q: How much does LinkedIn Sales Navigator cost?
faqs.a: LinkedIn lists Core from USD 119.99 per licence on monthly billing or USD 1,079.88 per year. Advanced starts at USD 159.99 monthly or USD 1,799.88 annually; Advanced Plus requires a quote. Prices were checked on 8 November 2026. Region, tax and checkout terms can change the amount.

faqs.q: Do you need both Apollo and Sales Navigator?
faqs.a: Use both when Sales Navigator adds account knowledge or useful relationships and Apollo supplies the contact data or outreach tools you need. Start with a small shared account sample. If the second subscription adds little useful information, keep the simpler setup.

faqs.q: Can CallTeam call the prospects we find on LinkedIn or Apollo?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring your target market and the list you are authorised to use. CallTeam can check the campaign fit, prepare the calling list, make the calls, follow up and arrange qualified appointments. We can also discuss list-building support if contact details are missing.
